animation_method: Idle: 100STYLE Neutral_ID frames 700-1300, recorded pelvis/chest/head/wrist deltas retargeted, bounded and loop-blended, feet fixed with IK. Serve/greet: original authored contact performance. All baked at 30 Hz. Weighted hem bones, not live cloth simulation.
source_license: Meshes/textures CC0-1.0; idle motion CC-BY-4.0; MPFB tool code GPL-3.0-or-later (not in game)
author_credit: MakeHuman team; Data Collection AB; Joel Palmius; Jonas Hauquier. Attribution voluntary for CC0.
original_additions: Cut draped apron with curved pocket, curved bound seams, cupped shoulder tapes, waist ties and hem bones; two articulated eye joints, skin-fitted relaxed eyebrows, runtime blink and smile shapes. Poly Haven Cotton Jersey CC0 PBR maps; colormass and Rico Cilliers, voluntary attribution.
modifications_r21: Original two-hand carry and weight shift. Washed green fabric, asymmetric bias folds, two skinned bib controls and three hem controls. Short04 CC0 texture repainted with temple grey and soft coverage; original UVs retained. R18 idle, greet and skin retained.
